text: {"score":2,"justification":"Core statistics match the card (20.7% vs 3.7%, z 3.06, 3 of 7 documented 99215s below billed, 5 of 21 no lab). But the summary has serious grounding problems. It cites C0081673 and C0081694 in the examples even though its own correction says neither should be used as below-billed evidence, and it states C0081694 was not a returned chart. Citing a claim that supports the bill and one with no records as examples is confusing. It also repeats statements, includes unsupported dollar figures, and contains an apparent drafting artifact. An investigator would have to clean it up.","problems":["Overpayment estimate $1,068 (CI $344-$1,791) is not on the evidence card and cannot be verified; the number check flagged it.","Includes a 'Correction to the draft summary' that references a prior draft, an artifact that confuses the reader.","Cites C0081673 (documented high MDM, supports billing) and C0081694 (no documentation returned) among the cited claims despite saying they should not be cited as below-billed evidence.","Redundant text: risk-adjusted score and the 39% low-complexity figure are stated twice, and the 3 of 7 and 5 of 21 findings are repeated.","'In a complete random sample of 30' is unsupported; the card only says 30 documented claims and does not say the sample was random or complete.","Headline says 'peer 0%' but the card shows an all-provider 99215 rate of 0.0 for below-billed; calling this a peer comparison is loosely worded.","Low-complexity share is stated as 39% of 99215s (0.388), but the example C0081799 has 4 conditions, so the examples mix complexity levels, and the summary does not explain that this claim is below billed despite high complexity.","Next steps are generic and do not mention missing minutes or the 3 below-billed claims specifically, and the summary does not flag that only 7 of 49 99215 claims were documented."]}
